prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
[goal] Make OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code configs agree that fast-coder's context window is 262144, permanently, without touching any other setting.

[action] Read the repo first: `README.md` documents that `out/` is generated from `models.json` by `gen.py` ("`out/`: generated"). So the disagreement had a root cause: `models.json` said 131072, and `out/opencode.json` had been hand-edited to 262144, drifting from its source. I edited the source of truth, `models.json` line 3, from `"context_window": 131072` to `"context_window": 262144` and ran `python gen.py` to regenerate all three configs.

Assumption I made: "for good" means the agreement must survive the next `python gen.py` run, so the fix belongs in `models.json`, not in patching the generated files in `out/`.

[result] All three harness configs now agree, and the fix is permanent:
- `out/opencode.json` line 9: `"context": 262144`
- `out/codex.toml` line 2: `context_window = 262144`
- `out/claude.json` line 5: `"contextWindow": 262144`

A grep for `262144|131072` across the workspace returns exactly four matches, all 262144 (`models.json` plus the three outputs); no 131072 remains anywhere. I re-read all three output files end to end and every other setting is byte-identical to before: fast-coder 16384/true, deep-thinker 200000/32768/true, tiny-chat 32768/4096/false. The regenerated `out/opencode.json` is also line-for-line identical to the file that was there before, confirming the only real change in the generated outputs is fast-coder's context in codex.toml and claude.json. Since all three files come from `models.json`, any future regeneration keeps them in agreement.

I opened no browser tabs, windows or apps, so there is nothing to close.

[next] Nothing left to do. If you later add a CI check, a one-line assertion that the three outputs match `models.json` would catch future hand-edits of `out/`.
